name: Calendly
tagline: Easy automated scheduling — send a link, they pick a time
verdictSummary: Core booking UI + Google Calendar API is doable in one sitting. The hard parts are timezone edge cases, team routing, and CRM integrations.
coreLoopDIY: Booking page with Google Calendar integration
whyPeopleStillPay: Teams needing advanced routing and CRM sync
